objective: Continue autonomously until verified apples-to-apples Pareto superiority over strongest current Laya and Jev, or a demonstrated terminal hard block after all reachable justified branches. CBF6 completion or failure is not terminal.
missing_Jev_terminal: VEY ENDGAME COMPLETE EXCEPT DIRECT JEV CONFIRMATION only after every other required milestone is verified; earlier absent credentials are not a stopping reason

comparison.quality_unit: Independent source example/document/session, grouped variants kept together
comparison.latency_unit: Paired interleaved quiet-hardware blocks; same runtime/hardware and documented precision/cache settings
comparison.superiority: Simultaneous confidence interval strictly excludes zero in favorable direction
comparison.non_inferiority: Simultaneous confidence interval excludes specified material regression; lack of significance is not equivalence

simultaneous_statistics.family: Every preregistered critical endpoint versus each directly evaluated competitor; freeze endpoint count before sealed head-to-head
simultaneous_statistics.correction: Bonferroni two-sided nominal95% family-wise intervals, paired cluster bootstrap10000seed0 except exact binary/bounded-risk intervals where applicable
simultaneous_statistics.binary_unit: One preregistered primary question per independent group; robustness variants remain clustered secondary endpoints
simultaneous_statistics.zero_discordance: A degenerate bootstrap alone cannot certify non-inferiority: add exact Clopper-Pearson bound on harmful paired discordance, or a deterministic equivalence proof when outputs are mathematically identical
simultaneous_statistics.insufficient_precision: Remain unmeasured/inconclusive, never turn low power or zero observed differences into equivalence
simultaneous_statistics.continuous_zero_variance: Require preregistered deterministic/bounded evidence rather than degenerate bootstrap superiority

fair_workflows: Identical decomposition, exact rules and shared workflow code for all systems wherever possible. Compare semantic decisions, not Vey's code against competitor neural arithmetic. Exact native architectural support can be compared separately, never fabricated as an accuracy win when both shared workflows are perfect.
